description: This file defines the DragManager class responsible for handling drag-and-drop operations within a Chromium-based browser context in the Playwright testing framework. It manages drag state, intercepts drag events, and communicates with the browser via protocol commands.

classes.name: DragManager
classes.description: Manages drag-and-drop interactions, including initiating, canceling, and dropping drag events, with integration into the Chromium protocol.

methods.name: cancelDrag
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing drag operation by sending a dragCancel event to the browser.

methods.name: interceptDragCausedByMove
methods.description: Handles drag interception caused by move events, setting up listeners, and managing drag state during move operations.

methods.name: isDragging
methods.description: Returns whether a drag operation is currently active.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Completes a drag operation by dispatching a drop event at specified coordinates.
